body.name: Data processing integrity and output validated
body.description: Processing is complete, accurate and tamper-evident end to end.
body.detail: All 2119 records across 5 batch(es) re-hashed and every chain re-walked; no discrepancy.
observations: This is a full re-hash of stored payloads, not a link-only check — the latter would miss an edit made directly in the database.
The same check is exposed at /integrity/verify, and /integrity/drill will break it on demand so the verifier can be watched catching it.
